header.title: Yomitan Token & Flama Connect Management
header.description: Integrate the browser Yomitan dictionary extension with Flama to automatically mine Flashcards in 1 click.

value_intro.title: Why combine Yomitan with Flama?
value_intro.subtitle: Turn any web page, news article, or manga into an automatic vocabulary mining ground without manual typing.
value_intro.before_p1: Highlighting text, switching tabs to dictionaries ➔ Breaks reading flow and focus.
value_intro.before_p2: Manually typing words, looking up Kanji, pasting meanings ➔ Takes 3–5 mins per card.
value_intro.before_p3: Procrastinating on card creation means forgetting everything after reading.
value_intro.after_p1: Hover to view Hiragana, Sino-Vietnamese / pitch accents, and definitions in place.
value_intro.after_p2: 1-Click (+) button sends term, definition, and audio directly into Flama.
value_intro.after_p3: Spaced Repetition (SRS) automatically schedules reviews right before you forget.
value_intro.step_1: 1. Read articles, web, or manga you enjoy
value_intro.step_2: 2. Hover over any word for instant 0.1s popup
value_intro.step_3: 3. Click (+) to auto-save Flashcard into Flama
value_intro.cta_label: Ready to connect the Yomitan extension with Flama?

header.title: asbplayer & Flama Connect Token Management
header.description: Integrate asbplayer extension with Flama Connect to mine sentences, images, and audio from video and anime directly into Flama.

value_intro.title: Why combine asbplayer with Flama?
value_intro.subtitle: Mine subtitle sentences, capture crystal-clear MP3 audio, and snapshot visual context directly from movies & anime.
value_intro.before_p1: Subtitles distract your eyes while fast-paced native speech slips past unnoticed.
value_intro.before_p2: Rewinding key dialogue on video progress bars is clunky and breaks immersion.
value_intro.before_p3: Closing the video loses the audio context with no structured way to review spoken nuance.
value_intro.after_p1: Millisecond-precise subtitle syncing with smart loop replay for difficult sentences.
value_intro.after_p2: 1 Hotkey automatically cuts the exact dialogue MP3 and takes a visual snapshot.
value_intro.after_p3: Review flashcards with authentic native voice acting and emotional intonation.
value_intro.step_1: 1. Play subtitled videos, Netflix, or anime
value_intro.step_2: 2. Press 1 hotkey to grab dialogue & MP3
value_intro.step_3: 3. Card appears in Flama ready for SRS review
value_intro.cta_label: Ready to connect the asbplayer extension to mine movies & anime?
